get.summary: List coordination issue viewpoints (legacy + Model Manager, REST v2.0)
get.description:
**GET collection** — returns every viewpoint mapping on the issue. **Legacy** rows (join has
`bim_viewpoint_id`) use **`BimViewpointBlueprint`** view **`:procore_v0_1`** — the **same** shape as
the **`viewpoints`** array on the coordination issue resource (`CoordinationIssueBlueprint` view
`:extended_with_viewpoint_v0_1`): `camera_data`, `sections_data`, `redlines_data`, `snapshot`,
`bim_file_id`, `uuid`, numeric `id`, etc.

**MM-backed** rows (`viewpoint_uuid` only) are loaded in bulk from Model Manager
(`POST .../bim/viewpoints/batch`) and appear as full MM viewpoint objects (same shape as
`GET .../viewpoints/{uuid}` inner `data`).

Order follows the join table: `position`, then `created_at`. Pagination counts **join rows**, not
only legacy viewpoints.

Supports pagination (`page`, `per_page`; default per page **10**, max **100** per
`Rest::V2::ApplicationController` / `RestV2Pagination`).

Response headers may include `Per-Page`, `Total`, and `Link` (RFC 5988) for pagination.

**502** if Model Manager returns 5xx while resolving MM-backed rows on this page.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
When `ids_only`, response body is `{ "data": [...] }`: legacy mappings use integer
`bim_viewpoint_id`; MM-backed mappings use UUID strings. Order matches the full list (`position`,
`created_at`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: primary
parameters.description:
When `true`, only mappings marked primary on the issue are returned. When `false`, only non-primary
mappings. When omitted, all mappings are returned (subject to pagination). Applies to both the full
list and `view=ids_only`.

parameters.name: included
parameters.description:
**Ignored.** The `viewpoint_format` query parameter now controls the response shape.
When `viewpoint_format=v2` (default), all viewpoints are returned in Model Manager shape.
When `viewpoint_format=v1`, all viewpoints are returned in legacy shape.

parameters.name: viewpoint_format
parameters.description:
Specify the response format for viewpoint data.
When `v1`, all viewpoints (including Model Manager-backed) are returned in legacy shape (`camera_data`, `sections_data`, `redlines_data` as JSON strings). Model Manager viewpoints are transformed to match the legacy BimViewpointBlueprint `:procore_v0_1` structure.
When `v2` (default), all viewpoints (including legacy BimViewpoints) are returned in Model Manager shape (structured `payload` object with nested `camera`, `clipping`, `markup`, `visibility`, `render_mode`). Legacy viewpoints are transformed to match the Model Manager viewpoint response structure.
Identity and reference fields (`id`, `uuid`, `scene_id`, `bim_file_id`, `company_id`, `project_id`, etc.) are never transformed — they pass through as-is from the source record. Fields not present on a source record appear as `null` in the response.

200.description: OK — merged viewpoint list or id list when `view=ids_only`

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

oneOf.title: Default — full viewpoint objects in data
oneOf.description:
Unless `view=ids_only`, each `data[]` element is either a legacy `:procore_v0_1` object or a
full Model Manager viewpoint (see nested oneOf on `data.items`).

allOf.title: Coordination issue viewpoints index — full objects
allOf.description:
Viewpoints for the issue in join-table order (`position`, then `created_at`). Pagination applies to
`bim_viewpoints_coordination_issues` rows. Each element is either a legacy row from
**`BimViewpointBlueprint`** view **`:procore_v0_1`** (same shape as coordination issue `viewpoints`) or a
BIM MM `ResponsesViewpointResponse` object (same shape as MM show/batch items).

data.description:
One entry per join row. Use **One Of** below to switch between the legacy blueprint fields and the Model Manager
viewpoint fields.

(`BimViewpointBlueprint` **`:procore_v0_1`**).

post.summary: Create a Model Manager viewpoint and link it to the issue (REST v2.0)
post.description:
Proxies to Model Manager `POST /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/bim/viewpoints`
(`RequestsCreateViewpointRequest`: `scene_id`, optional `name`, `payload` per MM OpenAPI), plus
**Procore-required** `bim_model_uuid` for application validation. Then inserts
`coordination_issue_bim_viewpoints` with `viewpoint_uuid` (MM viewpoint id).

May trigger notification side effects for observers of the issue.

schema.description:
BIM MM `RequestsCreateViewpointRequest` fields plus **Procore-only** `bim_model_uuid` (required by
monolith validation; not sent as a top-level field to Model Manager).

When **`payload` is omitted**, `ViewpointCreateViaModelManagerService` builds the MM payload from
`camera_data`, `sections_data` (mapped to `clipping.planes`), `redlines_data` (mapped to `markup`),
`visibility`, `render_mode`, and `name` only.

**`primary` and `position`** affect the local `coordination_issue_bim_viewpoints` row, not the MM payload shape.

**`bim_file_id`** and **`bim_view_folder_id`** are permitted by the controller but are **not** applied on the
Model Manager strategy; include any file/folder data inside **`payload`** if Model Manager should receive it.

**`snapshot_upload_uuid`** is consumed on the **legacy strategy only** (when `scene_id` / `bim_model_uuid` are
omitted): it is forwarded to the BIM viewpoint creator, which attaches the uploaded image as a `ProstoreFile`
on the resulting `BimViewpoint`. The Model Manager strategy ignores this field — include snapshot data inside
**`payload`** instead.

bim_model_uuid.description: Required by Procore `ViewpointCreateViaModelManagerService` validation (not sent to MM create as a top-level field).

oneOf.description:
Viewpoint payload sent to / returned from Model Manager. Matches BIM MM `TypesViewpointPayload`
(camera, clipping, visibility, snapshot, markup, measurements, etc.).
JSON string of a `TypesViewpointPayload` object (same shape as the object form).

camera_data.description:
Used when top-level `payload` is absent — becomes `camera` in the MM payload. Send a JSON object or a JSON string
(parsed server-side).

redlines_data.description: Used when top-level `payload` is absent — becomes `markup` in the MM payload (object or JSON string).

sections_data.description:
Used when top-level `payload` is absent — parsed value is set on `clipping.planes` in the MM payload.
Model Manager expects an array of clipping planes (`TypesClippingPlane`); object or JSON string is accepted and passed through after parse.

bim_file_id.description: Accepted in the JSON body for parity with other viewpoint APIs; **not** applied by MM create in this flow.

bim_view_folder_id.description: Accepted in the JSON body for parity with other viewpoint APIs; **not** applied by MM create in this flow.

snapshot_upload_uuid.description:
Upload UUID of a previously uploaded snapshot image (via `POST /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/uploads`).
**Legacy strategy:** the image is attached to the created `BimViewpoint` as a `ProstoreFile`; the snapshot URL
is returned on subsequent reads. **Model Manager strategy:** ignored at the top level — include snapshot data
inside `payload` instead.

primary.description: Sets `is_primary` on the coordination-issue viewpoint mapping.

position.description: Sets ordering `position` on the coordination-issue viewpoint mapping (auto-incremented if omitted).

schema.description: BIM MM `ViewpointResponseType1` — success responses include `data`; `error` when MM uses error envelope.

post.summary: Batch-get Model Manager viewpoints by UUID (REST v2.0, issue-scoped)
post.description:
Request body must include `ids` (non-empty array of UUID strings). The server **filters** `ids`
to those present on this issue as MM-backed mappings, preserves request order for the intersection,
then calls Model Manager `POST .../bim/viewpoints/batch`.

If no ids remain after filtering, returns `{ "data": [] }` **without** calling Model Manager.

Response body is forwarded from Model Manager (typically `{ "data": [ ... ] }`).

When `viewpoint_format=v1`, the Model Manager viewpoint objects are transformed to legacy shape
(camera_data, sections_data, redlines_data as JSON strings).
When `viewpoint_format=v2` (default), viewpoints are returned in Model Manager shape as-is.

parameters.name: viewpoint_format
parameters.description:
Specify the response format for viewpoint data.
When `v1`, all viewpoints (including Model Manager-backed) are returned in legacy shape (`camera_data`, `sections_data`, `redlines_data` as JSON strings). Model Manager viewpoints are transformed to match the legacy BimViewpointBlueprint `:procore_v0_1` structure.
When `v2` (default), all viewpoints (including legacy BimViewpoints) are returned in Model Manager shape (structured `payload` object with nested `camera`, `clipping`, `markup`, `visibility`, `render_mode`). Legacy viewpoints are transformed to match the Model Manager viewpoint response structure.
Identity and reference fields (`id`, `uuid`, `scene_id`, `bim_file_id`, `company_id`, `project_id`, etc.) are never transformed — they pass through as-is from the source record. Fields not present on a source record appear as `null` in the response.

patch.summary: Update viewpoint mapping and/or Model Manager viewpoint content (REST v2.0)
patch.description:
Updates the MM-backed mapping (`viewpoint_id` = `viewpoint_uuid`): **`primary`** and **`position`** on
`bim_viewpoints_coordination_issues`, and optionally **`name` / payload fields** via Model Manager PATCH.
Discrete fields (`camera_data`, `sections_data`, `redlines_data`, `visibility`, `render_mode`) are merged
into the current MM payload after loading the viewpoint from Model Manager, unless **`payload`** is sent
(full replace of MM payload).

Parity keys such as **`scene_id`** / **`bim_model_uuid`** are accepted but not applied on PATCH; a body
containing **only** those (and similar no-op) fields returns **422**.

When `primary` is `true`, any other primary mapping on this issue is cleared first (at most one primary).

Requires **at least one** attribute in the body. `position` must be an integer when provided
(unless explicitly set to `null` to clear). **502** if Model Manager returns 5xx.

schema.description:
Accepts the same optional fields as **POST create** (`viewpoint_create_request.yml`) for Model Manager content
(`name`, `payload`, discrete `camera_data` / `sections_data` / `redlines_data` / `visibility` / `render_mode`)
plus **`primary`** and **`position`** on the coordination-issue join row.

**At least one** property must be present.

Model Manager **PATCH** is invoked when `name`, `payload`, or any discrete payload field is sent. If discrete fields
are sent **without** top-level `payload`, the server **loads the current viewpoint from Model Manager**, **deep-merges**
your changes into the existing payload, and replaces the MM payload with the merged result.

**`scene_id`**, **`bim_model_uuid`**, **`bim_file_id`**, **`bim_view_folder_id`**, and **`snapshot_upload_uuid`** are
accepted for parity with create but are **not applied** on update (Model Manager PATCH does not relocate the viewpoint).
A body containing **only** those fields returns **422**.

When `primary` is `true`, any other primary mapping on this issue is cleared first (at most one primary).

name.description: Passed to Model Manager viewpoint PATCH (`name`) when provided.

scene_id.description: Accepted but not applied on PATCH (create-only relocation).

bim_model_uuid.description: Accepted but not applied on PATCH.

oneOf.description:
Viewpoint payload sent to / returned from Model Manager. Matches BIM MM `TypesViewpointPayload`
(camera, clipping, visibility, snapshot, markup, measurements, etc.).
JSON string of a `TypesViewpointPayload` object (replaces MM payload when sent).

camera_data.description: When `payload` is absent — merged into MM payload as `camera` (object or JSON string).

redlines_data.description: When `payload` is absent — merged into MM payload as `markup`.

sections_data.description: When `payload` is absent — merged into MM payload as `clipping.planes`.

bim_file_id.description: Accepted but not applied on this PATCH flow.

bim_view_folder_id.description: Accepted but not applied on this PATCH flow.

snapshot_upload_uuid.description: Accepted but not applied on this PATCH flow.

primary.description: Sets `is_primary` on the coordination-issue viewpoint mapping.

position.description: Sort order on the join row; send `null` to clear when supported by validation.

200.description:
OK — full Model Manager viewpoint under `data` (same idea as **GET** show for MM-backed rows), with
**`primary`** and **`position`** from the join row included.

x-changelog.description:
The update endpoint now supports legacy viewpoints (camera_data, sections_data,
redlines_data) and handles cross-format migration. Sending legacy params to an
MM-backed viewpoint migrates it to a BimViewpoint. Sending payload/scene_id to a
legacy viewpoint migrates it to Model Manager.

delete.summary: Remove viewpoint association from issue (REST v2.0; MM soft-delete when applicable)
delete.description:
Path parameter **`viewpoint_id`** must be a **UUID** (route constraint). The server resolves the join
row by **`viewpoint_uuid`** matching that id on this coordination issue (numeric `BimViewpoint` ids are
not valid on this path).

Transaction:
1. If the mapping has `viewpoint_uuid`, calls Model Manager `DELETE .../bim/viewpoints/{uuid}`.
   `404` from MM is ignored; local mapping is still removed.
2. Destroys the `coordination_issue_bim_viewpoints` row.

May trigger notification side effects for observers of the issue.

**Success response**: `head :ok` → **HTTP 200** with **no response body**.

get.summary: Resolve scene_id to bim_model_id for viewpoint deep linking
get.description:
Resolves a platform `scene_id` (from a Model Manager viewpoint) to the corresponding
`bim_model_id`. This endpoint is used by the CI MFE to construct deep-link URLs to
the document viewer with viewpoint restoration.

The resolution happens via the Model Manager service: queries model revisions filtered
by `current_platform_scene_id` and returns the `bim_model_id` from the first matching
revision.

**Not nested under a coordination issue** — authorized at the project level.

parameters.name: scene_id
parameters.description: Platform scene UUID from the Model Manager viewpoint's `scene_id` field.

bim_model_id.description: The BIM model UUID that owns the given scene.
